RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 4, 2002/Agrahayana 13, 1924 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Coal and Mines; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions—20
67
Induction of AJT in Defence
*221. SHRI S. AGNIRAJ: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) what steps are being taken to induct
AJT in Indian Air Force;
(b) what is the reason for delay;
(c) when it is likely to be inducted; and
(d) whether financial constraints are
prohibiting the implementation and if so,
the details thereof?
Terrorist activities from Bhutan
*222. SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
SHRI KARNENDU BHATTA-
CHARJEE:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that the militants are carrying on
terrorist activities on a large scale from
Bhutan alongwith the Assam-Bhutan
border;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken/proposed to be taken in this regard;
(c) whether the Central Government
have received any request from the State
Government of Assam to flush out National
Democratic Front for Bodoland (N.D.F.B.)
militants; if so, the details thereof; and
(d) Government's reaction thereto and
steps contemplated in this direction?
Jai Prakash Rozgar Guarantee
Yojana
*223. SHRI K. NATWAR SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether a Rs. 5,000 crore
employment guarantee scheme known as
Jai Prakash Rozgar Guarantee Yojana, in
130 most-backward districts of the country,
will be launched this year;
(b) if so, the details of the scheme;
(c) whether a task force was set up by
Government for selection of the districts to
be included in the said scheme;
(d) if so, what are the names of the
districts selected; and
(e) by when the work on this scheme is
likely to be started?
Deportation of Abu Salem to India
*224. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY :
DR. PRABHA THAKUR:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the underworld don,

Lisbon;
(b) if so, whether a CBI team has been
sent to Lisbon to get Abu Salem deport to
India;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) the details of other steps Government
have taken to ensure deportation of
Abu Salem to India?
Rehabilitation package for riot
victims in Gujarat
*225. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
prepared a rehabilitation package for riot
affected people of Gujarat;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the reasons for delay in finalising the
package?
Insurance schemes for handloom
weavers in Andhra Pradesh
*226. DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO: Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether insurance schemes have
been extended to the handloom weavers of
Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the number of weavers
covered under the schemes as on date,
district-wise;
(c) the details of the terms and conditions
of the schemes; and
(d) the role being played by Central and
State Governments in this regard?
Cooperation of State Governments in
NCC activities
*227. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the State
Governments are not cooperating in the
National Cadet Corps (NCC) activities in
their States causing great difficulty to the
NCC;
(b) if so, the States which are not
cooperating; and
(c) the steps being taken by Government
to ensure cooperation and help of all States
in activities of NCC?
Assistance to S.E.R.Cs
*228. SHRI S.M. LAL JAN BASHA:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government have a plan to
assist the State Electricity Regulatory
Commission, based on their performance;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether money has been released to
any State Electricity Regulatory
Commission under this incentive scheme;
and
(d) if so, the details of funds released?
Aircraft crashes
*229. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the recent
accidents of Air Force aircrafts, MIG,
Jaguar, etc. and the mid-air collision of two
Russian-made long-range IL-38 maritime
reconnaissance aircrafts at Goa, present a

preparedness; and
(b) if so, the reasons for this state of
affairs and what is the gist of the
recommendations of the various Enquiry

accidents during the last three years?
